title: InventoryReservation - Data API
description: Stores information about the status of cart inventory reservations in B2B and D2C Commerce. This object is available in API version 60.0 and later.

ErrorCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ErrorCode.description: The error code if the reservation isn’t successful.

ErrorMessage.description: If an error occurred, this field contains the error message.

InventoryReservationName.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
InventoryReservationName.description: Name of the inventory reservation (autogenerated, for example: PIR-0033).

IsAsyncOperationInProgress.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsAsyncOperationInProgress.description: Indicates if there’s an async operation in progress that could affect the reservation. The default value is false.

IsSuccess.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsSuccess.description: Indicates whether the most recent inventory system operation was successful. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user could have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The user who owns the inventory reservation. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ReservationDate.description: The timestamp when the inventory reservation was created.

ReservationDurationInSeconds.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReservationDurationInSeconds.description: The total duration of the inventory reservation in seconds.

ReservationIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReservationIdentifier.description: The unique identifier (text value) for the reservation.

ReservationSourceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReservationSourceId.description: The ID of the entity associated with the inventory reservation. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
